src=/srv/legacy2/hardlink-aware-deduplication/release-cache/r1/payload.dat

[ "$mutable_inode" != "$src_inode" ]
[ "$private_inode" != "$src_inode" ]
[ -w "$base/mutable/active.dat" ]
